title: AOL LLC - proposed acquisition of Bebo Inc

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: AOL LLC proposes to acquire Bebo Inc.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC did not form a definitive view in relation to market definition. However, the ACCC considered that the transaction would be unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition regardless of the way the market was defined.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the transaction was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition, primarily due to the dynamic nature of the industry, the presence of a large number of other significant competitors and the differences in service offerings of each party.
